'''ANDAH IS A WORK OF FICTION AND MAKES NO CLAIM TO FACTUAL ACCURACY.'''

Andah, known on Earth as Janus, is a fictional planet. This wiki documents that planet as part of the [[Andah:About|Andah/Janus world-building project]]. Its articles use the conventions of an encyclopedia, including infoboxes, dated events, population tables and footnoted citations, but their content is invented throughout. This disclaimer applies to all pages in all namespaces.

== A work of fiction ==

Andah's 172 nations, their cities, borders, populations, languages, religions, currencies and recorded histories do not exist and never have. The in-universe present is the year 1765, and dates on this wiki refer to that fictional calendar.

Nothing here is suitable as a source for schoolwork, research, journalism or any decision of consequence. Articles that appear to describe real subjects should still be read as fiction.

== Citations and sources ==

Articles carry <code><nowiki><ref></nowiki></code> footnotes and ''References'' sections. '''These are part of the fiction.''' The bodies they cite, among them the Global Trade Union, the World Data Union, the Krali Development Report, ''The Andah Factbook'', BBC News Andah and the FLLA, are fictional in-universe organisations that publish nothing on Earth. No figure attributed to them has any standing outside this project, and where such a name resembles a real organisation, no connection is implied.

== Resemblance and content ==

Real names, languages, religious traditions and political forms have been drawn on as inspiration. Any resemblance to a real country, culture, institution or person, living or dead, is coincidental, and is not a portrayal of that subject.

Because Andah has an invented history spanning centuries, articles describe war, colonisation, famine, persecution and religious and political conflict, which some readers may find distressing. These depictions are not endorsements, and the fictional religions and ideologies described here imply no position on any real belief or people.

== No warranty ==

This wiki has no formal review process. Articles may be incomplete, inconsistent or wrong on their own terms, and no warranty of any kind is given. Content may be rewritten or deleted at any time as the setting develops; canon is whatever the current version of a page says.

Content is available under CC BY-SA 4.0 except where stated otherwise, and material adapted from Wikipedia remains under its original terms. See [[Andah:Copyrights]].
